Government-sector candidates also have additional document-forwarding requirements.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Age, educational qualification and professional experience will be calculated as on 1 October 2026. Candidates should complete online registration before the deadline because the company will not be responsible for last-minute technical or network issues.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The number of vacancies may change according to MMRCL requirements. Applicants claiming reservation must comply with the category-specific conditions and certificate requirements.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited issued for 35 regular, contractual and deputation positions.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must possess the relevant full-time degree, diploma or professional qualification and the mandatory post-qualification experience specified for their position. Educational qualifications and experience are assessed as on 1 October 2026. Experience Warning: These are broad post-category summaries. The notification specifies separate IDA/CDA pay-grade conditions, minimum years in particular grades and private-sector CTC thresholds. Candidates must meet the exact criteria for their selected position rather than relying on the general experience figure alone.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The advertised posts carry different Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) pay scales based on their grade and responsibilities. These figures are notified pay scales, not fixed take-home salaries. Pay and benefits for deputation appointments will be governed by the applicable DoPT, DPE and Government of India guidelines.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates should follow the official application portal instructions without assuming an unannounced fee or exemption.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on shortlisting of eligible and experienced candidates followed by a Personal Interview . Application Screening: MMRCL will examine applications for educational qualifications, relevant experience, eligibility and other requirements. Shortlisting: Candidates may be shortlisted for interview based on their professional qualifications and experience in the relevant field. Personal Interview: Shortlisted applicants will be called for an interview. Document Verification: Candidates must produce the required educational, employment, experience and category documents when requested. Final Selection: Appointment will be subject to the applicable recruitment requirements and other prescribed conditions.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Surety Bond
content_sections.text: Selected candidates appointed on regular or contractual basis must execute the prescribed surety bond under the MMRCL Surety and Training Cost Recovery Bond Policy, revised on 13 January 2026. Bond Service Period: The service period for regular appointments is three years. For contractual appointments, it is one year less than the contract duration, subject to a maximum of three years. Important: The Surety and Training Cost Recovery Bond Policy does not apply to candidates appointed on deputation basis.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can submit applications through the official MMRCL recruitment website from 31 October 2026 at 10:00 AM until 30 November 2026 at 11:59 PM . Apply Online: Official Recruitment Portal: recruitment.mmrcl.com Applicants must indicate whether they are seeking consideration for regular, contractual or deputation appointment, according to the options available for their selected post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for MMRCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the prescribed documents and keep supporting certificates ready for verification. Updated resume. Recent passport-size photograph in JPG/JPEG format. Recent payslip in PDF format. Relevant degree, diploma or professional qualification certificates. Documents establishing required post-qualification experience. Employment and pay-scale records, where applicable. SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS/PwD or other eligible category certificates, if applicable. Other documents requested by the scrutiny committee. Candidates applying from Government departments and other applicable public-sector organizations must also forward the prescribed application and supporting records through the required official channel. Latest resume, photograph and educational qualification certificates. Work-experience certificates. No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the current employer. Attested ACR/APAR copies for the last five years. Vigilance clearance certificate. No Penalty Certificate or details of penalties imposed during the last ten years. Important: Government-sector applicants must complete online registration as well as the applicable forwarding requirements. The notification requires NOC and APAR documents from the present employer no later than three working days before the interview.

content_sections.heading: MMRCL Recruitment 2026 Postal Address
content_sections.text: Government-sector candidates required to forward their applications and supporting documents must use the following address: To, General Manager (HR & Admin), Mumbai Metro Rail Corporation Limited, MMRCL - Line 3 Transit Office, E Block, Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai - 400051. The sealed envelope must be superscribed with the name of the post applied for, as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q1. Which is the lowest-graded post in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Jr. Engineer-II posts in grade W6 carry the lowest pay scale, Rs. 35,280 – 67,920. They have 6 vacancies across E&M, D / Civil/Architectural and S&T.

faq.question: Q2. Which post has the most vacancies?
faq.answer: Deputy Engineer (Civil/Planning) has 04 vacancies, split as one each for UR, EWS, OBC and SC.

faq.question: Q3. Can a private-sector employee apply?
faq.answer: Yes, each post detailed in the notice has a private-sector route with its own experience and CTC floor. Deputy Engineer applicants, for example, need 07 years in Executive grade and a minimum CTC of Rs. 10 Lacs.

faq.question: Q4. Are the Jr. Engineer posts open on deputation?
faq.answer: No. Systems Analyst / Jr. Engineer-I and all three Jr. Engineer-II posts are on Contract (05 yrs) only.

faq.question: Q5. Which posts are offered on a regular basis?
faq.answer: Only General Manager (Buildings and Maintenance), Deputy General Manager (E&M) and Deputy General Manager (HQ/Systems) are offered on Regular or Deputation basis.

faq.question: Q6. Can AMIE holders apply?
faq.answer: For the General Manager and the two Deputy General Manager posts, AMIE (B.E/B.Tech) candidates who enrolled on or before 31 May 2013 may be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Can a Cost Accountant apply for the Finance posts?
faq.answer: Yes, provided the candidate is also a Commerce graduate from a recognised university. Assistant General Manager (Finance) asks for 09 years of post-qualification experience, and Junior Manager (Finance) for a minimum of 03 years.

faq.question: Q8. Which posts are reserved for ST candidates?
faq.answer: One vacancy each in Assistant General Manager (Civil) and Assistant General Manager (E&M) is reserved for ST candidates. Each has a maximum age of 40 years.
